content.title: Open a recently published book title from the home page and reach that book's detail page
content.intent: Prove that a visitor can use a title link in the `Recently published` section to open the detail page for that same displayed book.
content.technique_notes: I could mint 1 scenario: 1 happy. Applied source-grounded happy-path coverage and equivalence partitioning to the four recently published title links because the source promised the same outcome for each tile title. Kept this as one scenario with equivalent-control variation because choosing a different displayed title should not change the outcome family. No boundary, negative, covering-array, or budget cut applied because this route exposes no constrained input, no outcome-changing combinations, and no budget ceiling was provided. Full-set budget rank 4/4 because it covers the last distinct public branch off the home page.

selected_recently_published_title: any displayed recently published book title
